translation: Let me now explain the rules of chess.

In this mode, your objective is to solve the
chess puzzles…

…which each of the characters present to
you.

Before you get into the chess puzzles, we'll
first go through a step-by-step explanation…
…to help you learn the rules of chess.
Let's start with an overview of chess.

Chess is played on a board split into an 8x8
grid, as shown on the bottom screen.
There are two opposing players.

The players are divided into white (moves
first) and black, and take turns moving pieces.

The first player to checkmate the opponent's
king is the winner.

Each player has 16 pieces, of which there are
6 types. The game starts with them lined up.

The six piece types are:
Kings
Queens
Bishops
Knights
Rooks
Pawns

Those six piece types line up as shown on the
bottom screen.

Make sure that opposing kings and queens
are facing each other.

The placement of the pieces is not
point-symmetric.

White makes the first move, and the players
will take turns making moves from there on.

The white queen has put the black king in
checkmate.
That concludes the overview of chess.
